baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative to follow the speakers' path is immediately coupled to their offer to carry the followers' sins.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following is not only motion behind a leader: its branch inventory also names the adverse claim that attaches because of an act. The recruitment command therefore creates the very liability that the speakers offer to guarantee away.

activation_trace.role: Trailing and emulation supply the commanded movement behind the speakers.
An attached claim or adverse consequence makes the act of following itself liability-bearing.
Surety and guarantee frame the offer as an undertaking to answer for another.
Culpable sin supplies the moral claim supposedly covered by the undertaking.

changed_reading.before: The speakers simply invite believers to follow and promise to assume the resulting sins.
changed_reading.after: They recruit believers into a relation whose following already incurs an attached claim, then offer an unenforceable guarantee against that claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same carrying root appears first in the speakers' promise and then in an emphatic denial that they bear any part of the others' sins.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse stages a surety contract and voids it in place. Repeated burden language, preserved possessive ownership of each group's sins, and the denial of even one identifiable thing block the promised transfer.

activation_trace.role: Bearing an entrusted burden makes moral responsibility the load at issue in both promise and denial.
Guarantee and indemnity give the promise its legal-social form.
A thing that can be identified and reported supplies the denied minimum unit of transfer.
Contradiction of truth classifies the guarantee itself rather than merely its eventual performance.

changed_reading.before: The speakers make a broad promise that later proves false.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs a failed indemnity: no smallest reportable portion leaves its owner, so the contract is false at issuance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Those identified by the unbelief root offer to deal with the believers' sins and are then called liars.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers' root inventory holds both concealment and the covering-away of sin. Beside their offer to carry sins, that polysemy makes the speech resemble counterfeit expiation: concealers claim the power to cover consequences.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment characterize the speakers' stance toward what is exposed.
The branch of covering away an offense supplies the expiatory power implicitly counterfeited by their offer.
Sin and offense provide the object that genuine expiation would have to address.
The closing truth-value judgment exposes the offered covering as counterfeit.

changed_reading.before: Unbelievers lie about carrying another group's sins.
changed_reading.after: People defined by covering truth market a false human substitute for covering sin.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A spoken command asks believers to trust the speakers' own path, backed by a promise of consequence-bearing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech as doctrine, belief as settled trust, a traversable path, and surety combine into a recruitment pitch. The offer is not casual companionship but an attempt to relocate confidence into the speakers' worldview and protection.

activation_trace.role: Speech as adopted doctrine turns the utterance into a worldview claim.
Settled trust and safety identify what the speakers seek to redirect.
A traversable route gives the doctrine a practical course and claimed destination.
A guarantee supplies the protection used to secure assent.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an invitation to adopt the unbelievers' way.
changed_reading.after: It records doctrinal recruitment secured by a promise that asks believers to exchange their settled trust for human surety.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, strenuous action returns to the actor's own self; later, each community is seized by its own sin and wrongs its own selves. This self-bounded accounting sharpens the focus possessives: another party cannot detach a deed's consequence from its agent.

activation_trace.role: Culpable offense anchors the model in the separately possessed sins of the two groups.
Exertion under hardship supplies an action whose return is explicitly bounded to its doer.
The self as the thing itself fixes the beneficiary and bearer of the action.
Sin as culpability is attached distributively to each one seized.
The self as the actor's own identity makes wrongdoing reflexively return upon its agents.

structural_cues: At 29:6 the exertion root repeats around a phrase assigning its return to the doer's self; at 29:40 each is taken for its own sin and the wrongdoing turns upon their own selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reflexive and distributive ownership; I infer that this pattern blocks substitution of bearers in 29:12. A live alternative is that the context asserts personal return without formulating a general rule of non-transfer.

changed_reading.before: The promise might fail only because these particular guarantors are unable or unwilling to perform it.
changed_reading.after: The promise conflicts with the surah's self-bounded moral accounting: action and culpability return to their own agent, regardless of a recruiter's assurance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same covering root that labels the focus speakers is used at 29:7 for a divine act upon bad deeds, in a sequence of intentional action and recompense. Real covering is thus actor-qualified and tied to transformed action; the speakers' burden-transfer offer imitates that function without possessing it.

activation_trace.role: The expiation branch latent in the speakers' identifying root supplies the function their promise counterfeits.
Culpable sin is the object whose removal or transfer is disputed.
Intentional doing places actual conduct on both sides of the divine covering and recompense.
Covering an offense is performed by the divine subject here, supplying the valid counterpart to the focus offer.
Matching action with its recompense supplies an ordered alternative to arbitrary transfer.

structural_cues: At 29:7 the divine first-person subject covers their bad deeds; at 29:12 unbelieving human speakers offer to carry your sins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared root branch, different agents, and different action structures; I infer a deliberate contrast between valid divine expiation and counterfeit human indemnity. Alternatively, the focus use may function only as an identity label without activating expiation.

changed_reading.before: The unbelievers merely promise an impossible redistribution of guilt.
changed_reading.after: Their promise counterfeits a covering function the surah has already assigned to God in response to faith and action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent ayah ironically grants the recruiters a future carrying, but changes its arithmetic: their own loads remain and additional loads are stacked with them. Questioning for fabrication turns the added weight into liability incurred by misleading speech, not guilt successfully removed from followers.

activation_trace.role: The offered guarantee establishes the transfer claim that the next ayah reverses.
Culpable sins remain grammatically possessed by the followers and by the speakers.
Bearing moral responsibility supplies the recruiters' real future load rather than the promised substitution.
The repeated heavy-load image makes liability cumulative and explicitly added to what is already borne.
Demand and questioning convert the fabricated assurance into an answerable claim.
Invented falsehood identifies the speech act that generates the additional liability.

structural_cues: The immediate 29:12 to 29:13 sequence shifts from your sins and their sins to their loads, loads with their loads, and questioning for what they fabricated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied transfer, retained own loads, added loads, and accountability for fabrication; I infer that misleading others adds recruiter liability without subtracting follower guilt. A live alternative is that the extra loads cover broader consequences not limited to this invitation.

changed_reading.before: The speakers will carry none of the followers' sins.
changed_reading.after: They will indeed carry extra weight, but as additive liability for deceptive recruitment; nothing is transferred away from those who follow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus offer builds a protection relation: follow our route and our guarantee will shelter you. Later worldly affection reverses into mutual disavowal, while non-divine patrons are figured as a woven but weak house. The promised burden-sharing is therefore social architecture that looks connective yet cannot shelter.

activation_trace.role: Trust and felt safety supply the human need targeted by the recruitment offer.
Surety turns companionship into a claimed structure of protection.
Affection supplies the worldly bond that initially holds the alliance together.
Disavowal and repudiation reverse the alliance when its guarantee is needed.
Supportive alliance and patronage supply the social role being compared to a weak shelter.
The weaving creature supplies a visibly connected structure whose connections do not guarantee protection.
Shelter and dwelling turn the patronage relation into protective architecture.
Loss of strength diagnoses why the apparent shelter cannot perform its protective claim.

structural_cues: At 29:25 affection between allies becomes mutual repudiation; at 29:41 adopted patrons are compared to a spider adopting a house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surety in the focus, collapsing alliance at 29:25, and weak patron-shelter at 29:41; I infer that the focus promise is one instance of this failed protection architecture. Alternatively, the later images may target cultic patronage without directly extending to this recruitment speech.

changed_reading.before: The speakers offer solidarity by volunteering to absorb consequences.
changed_reading.after: They invite believers into a patronage house whose affection becomes repudiation and whose visible network cannot bear protective weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers' possessive path is one claimant within a contested guidance system. Decorated deeds can divert people from the path despite insight, while the surah closes with God guiding strivers to divine paths. The human command to follow is thus a rival claim to route-selection and vision.

activation_trace.role: Following and emulation make the speakers claim authority over movement.
A traversable route anchors the rival first-person path claim.
Making deeds appear attractive supplies the perceptual mechanism that recruits people onto a wrong route.
Turning and diverting make path capture an active redirection rather than neutral travel.
The same route image names what decorated conduct turns people away from.
Inner discernment shows that possessing insight does not by itself prevent social redirection.
Gentle direction toward the true route supplies the answering guidance agency.
Divine first-person paths answer and displace the speakers' first-person path.

structural_cues: The focus has the unbelievers' first-person path claim; 29:38 joins decorated deeds, diversion, the path, and insight; the closing 29:69 promises divine guidance to first-person paths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the possessive path echo and opposing diversion-guidance sequence; I infer that the closing path claim answers the focus invitation. A live alternative is that repeated path language is thematic rather than a direct inclusio.

changed_reading.before: The unbelievers ask the believers to travel their chosen moral route.
changed_reading.after: They compete for the authority to name 'our path'; the surah exposes how such routes capture vision and closes by relocating that possessive claim to divine guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus addresses people marked by trust and offers them human consequence-insurance. At 29:67 concrete sanctuary-security stands amid external snatching, while belief is placed in falsehood and blessing is covered. The offer now reads as an attempt to exchange provided security for confidence in a false claim.

activation_trace.role: Settled trust and safety identify the disposition targeted by the speakers.
Guarantee and surety turn the speech into consequence-insurance.
A protected sanctuary gives security a concrete spatial boundary.
The shared trust-security branch links the safe place to the later act of misplaced belief.
Swift seizure outside the sanctuary supplies the danger against which real security is measured.
A claim without reality classifies the alternative object of trust.
Covering and denying a benefit explains how provided safety can be exchanged for false assurance.

structural_cues: At 29:67 a secure sanctuary is contrasted with people being snatched around it, then belief in falsehood is paired with covering divine blessing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a trust-security root shared by focus and context plus a falsehood-security contrast; I infer that the burden promise markets counterfeit safety. Alternatively, the focus belief form may remain primarily doctrinal rather than affective security.

changed_reading.before: The speakers offer a doctrinal argument backed by a promise.
changed_reading.after: They market false consequence-insurance to people whose trust should recognize already provided security.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's secondary mapping from the speech root to a form-distant lifting branch, not the ordinary sense of the focus verb. It remains anchored because that mapped inventory is explicitly supplied and the utterance is juxtaposed with carrying twice. Render only as a sound-and-branch echo, never as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening speech verb introduces a promise to carry, followed by denial of carrying.

activation_trace.role: Lifting, bearing, and rising make the secondary mapping of the utterance echo the promised load-bearing.
Visible carrying supplies the action that the speech claims and the verse then negates.
The final falsehood judgment collapses verbal lifting into unsupported lift-talk.

changed_reading.before: A false statement precedes a failed promise to carry.
changed_reading.after: The utterance itself briefly sounds like an act of lifting, but the repeated carrying denial leaves it as speech that raises no load.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the path root's medically distant eye-film branch. It remains packet-anchored because that branch explicitly invokes web-like opacity and 29:41 supplies a weaving spider, house, and weakness, while 29:38 supplies impaired practical insight around the path. Downstream prose should present it only as a controlled visual analogy, not as the lexical meaning of 'path.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speakers claim ownership of the path they command believers to follow.

activation_trace.role: A web-like opacity over the eye lets the claimed route double as an instrument that clouds sight.
Inner discernment supplies the perceptual faculty that path diversion can fail to protect.
The weaving spider materializes the web image latent in the distant focus branch.
Shelter turns the web from a line of travel into an enclosing protection claim.
Weakness exposes the enclosing web as both occlusive and unable to protect.

changed_reading.before: Their path is simply the route they want believers to take.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their path is also a webbed eye-film: an enclosing social route that clouds discernment while offering only weak shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the sin root into its remote image of ground missed by rain. It remains anchored in the supplied focus branch and in 29:63's explicit descent of water and revival of earth. Render it as a material analogy about failed reception and restoration, not as an etymological definition of sins in the focus.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speakers treat the two groups' sins as cargo that could be moved between bearers.

activation_trace.role: Ground missed by rain recasts error as failed arrival or reception rather than detachable cargo.
Delivery downward supplies the corrected arrival of what the missed ground lacked.
Water conveyed by pouring supplies the life-bearing material whose trajectory reaches the earth.
Earth revived by rain supplies restoration as the result of right reception.
Soft growing ground supplies the receptive site transformed when water arrives.

changed_reading.before: Sins are burdens that the speakers falsely offer to transport from one person to another.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, sins also mark a missed life-giving alignment; the needed change is restored reception, not relocation of cargo to a surrogate.

strongest_changes: The immediate next ayah converts promised substitution into cumulative recruiter liability: extra loads are carried with, not instead of, existing loads.
The divine covering of bad deeds at 29:7 exposes the human offer as counterfeit expiation rather than merely an impractical promise.
The possessive path claim is answered by diversion imagery at 29:38 and divine possessive paths at 29:69, making the focus a contest over guidance authority.
The alliance-collapse and weak-house sequence at 29:25 and 29:41 recasts burden-sharing as failed patronage architecture.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus roots interact rather than merely recur: following generates attached liability, covering truth counterfeits covering sin, surety becomes a weak social shelter, and a claimed path competes with divine guidance. The focus is therefore a recruitment contract whose promise fails yet still adds liability to its issuers.
remaining_uncertainties: The adjacent ayah does not explicitly assign every added load to this exact invitation, so the recruiter-liability link remains an inference from sequence and fabrication.
The expiation contrast depends on activating the covering-away-sin branch beside a surface form denoting unbelief.
The spider-eye and missed-rain readings are branch-grounded cross-domain analogies and should remain explicitly exploratory.
